description: hashRace rounds x, y, vx and vy to whole numbers
find: parts.push(p.kind, p.x, p.y, p.heading, p.vx, p.vy, p.lap, p.next, p.finished ? 1 : 0, p.finishTick ?? -1);
replace: parts.push(p.kind, Math.round(p.x), Math.round(p.y), p.heading, Math.round(p.vx), Math.round(p.vy), p.lap, p.next, p.finished ? 1 : 0, p.finishTick ?? -1);
